content.introduction: The Federal Reserve Meeting Calendar for 2027 includes meetings on January 26-27, March 16-17, April 26-27, June 7-8, July 26-27, September 13-14, October 25-26, and December 7-8. The meetings are scheduled for the second and third days of each month, with decisions released on the third day at 2 p.m. Eastern Time. The Chair holds a news conference at 2:30 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day. The sources don't provide a definitive answer for 2026 meetings.
